name: clickify
description: Real-time voice AI assistant that lives on your screen

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['src/renderer/index.html','src/renderer/hint.html','src/renderer/settings.html'].forEach(f=>{ fs.mkdirSync('dist/renderer',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(f, f.replace('src/','dist/')); }); if(fs.existsSync('assets/icon.png')){ fs.mkdirSync('dist/assets',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('assets/icon.png','dist/assets/icon.png'); }"
scripts.package: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
